best_idea: One roll per tick maps to a damage multiplier with a partial band (1 down to 0) and a critical band, so a resisted hit shows as a smaller number and a full resist ends the sustained effect; the caster's energy pays each tick and the effect ends when it runs out.
decision_why: The one-roll partial band fits fast many-vs-one fights and magic resist, and the per-tick upkeep fits channelled spells; the donor's driver is disabled, the target defence is missing, the factor is applied twice for a DoT, and the multi-target loop returns early; the sketch fixes the first three and the note's section 6 lists the fix for the loop, so none is copied.
acceptance: A player's sustained spell on a target shows a tick every tuned interval with damage at full, partial (smaller number) or zero (resisted), and the link ends when the caster's energy is spent; a server test asserts one factor per tick, the upkeep order, and that the second target still gets the spell when the first already has it.
